static_traits.name: Lin Taile
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;此前not yet接受其他心理咨询;肩痛为首次出现,已持续数月.
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude,配合度高;表达清晰,能描述症状与trigger情境;能进行自我观察并愿意尝试建议;因疼痛感到挫败与压力.

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在经历肩部疼痛,我认为是吊带导致的.not过我也觉得体重可能加重了not适.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为肩部疼痛影响了我的日常生活并造成not适;我希望找到更好的管理方式,我愿意探索调整和建议.

core_beliefs: My physical condition (weight) is the root of the problem; the pain is mainly caused by my own factors

special_situations.event: Shoulder pain clearly worsens when wearing a sling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If pain occurs while wearing the sling, it is mainly because my weight is too great, causing the shoulder to bear too much load
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries adjusting the straps, reducing wearing time, and considers relieving the shoulder burden through self-management
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my weight straining my shoulders

special_situations.event: Pain worsens when performing heavy physical or repetitive activities that strain the shoulders
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在这些活动中出现疼痛,是因为我have not照顾好自己/体重过高所致
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or avoids heavy physical activity, rests frequently to reduce pain

special_situations.event: 与朋友交流肩痛但他们without法提供解决方案
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人帮not了我,说明问题在我身上,是我个人的过错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes the cause to oneself and tries to find solutions alone

core_conflict.wish: Longs to reduce physical pain and obtain effective support and solutions
core_conflict.fear: Fears the pain will persist and affect life functioning and emotional state
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control over the problem through self-explanation and self-adjustment

object_relations.self_representation: Individual who needs help but is troubled by pain
object_relations.object_representation: 关心但without法提供实际解决方案的他人/朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当疼痛原因not明确且症状持续影响日常功能时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to attribute the pain mainly to their own weight, thereby simplifying complex factors and maintaining a controllable explanation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和,探询式语言,提出多元可能原因,避免直接negate其Interpretation;邀请共同检验假设并通过实验收集证据.

manifestations: 肩部疼痛限制了日常活动与身体Freedom度(如Wearing a sling,重体力活动时受限)
outcomes: Decreased convenience of life and limited functioning

positive_force: Willing to seek help and maintain a positive attitude(主动来访,表示愿意尝试建议)
具备自我观察能力,能识do not疼痛与吊带,活动的关系
Has some social support (a few friends to confide in)
negative_force: 肩部疼痛持续存在,导致活动受限与not便
Excessive personalization attribution, tends to blame the pain on weight
Stress and emotional distress caused by pain
Currently lacking effective pain management strategies (adjusting the sling and painkillers have limited effect)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or reduces activities that strain the shoulder due to shoulder pain
antecedent: Performs heavy physical or repetitive activities that strain the shoulder
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心加重疼痛并体验到显著not适
target_behavior.function: 逃避疼痛与not适,降低即时身体负荷
target_behavior.consequence: 日常活动受限,Decreased efficiency,生活便利度降低

target_behavior.behavior: Self-blaming thinking (attributing pain mainly to weight)
antecedent: 他人without法提供解决方案的交流情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 通过单一归因获得心理上的Interpretation与控制感,减轻not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a subjective sense of control and problem framing
target_behavior.consequence: 增加自责与压力,可能忽视其他原因与解决路径,问题得not到有效缓解
